Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: EQ Rocket Launcher
Range: Mis. Launcher
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniping Scope, Rocket Long Tube, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Modular Rails
Alt. fire: Explosive

Fires Smart Rockets without Targeting Scope cyberware. Against vehicles, FBCs, or drones, Improved Smart ammo rerolls damage dice showing 1 until higher. The magazine can hold up to 5 ammo types at once; choose per shot. Reloading takes 3 Reload Actions.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
